title: Audit Rating filter visual depth
description: Audit Rating for star/icon rendering, threshold semantics, icon library support, counts, labels, states, and field binding.
objective: Make Rating a professional filter type instead of a shallow option list with a rating label.
expected_outputs: Current anatomy and render mode map
acceptance_criteria: The audit explains whether Rating is its own filter type or an option-family variant in the current code.
The audit recommends how icons, stars, half states, counts, labels, and selected states should be controlled.
The audit identifies the data type and compare behavior required for rating fields.
The audit does not stop at adding a star icon.
verification: Findings cite PHP render, resolver, CSS, and control paths.
No Rating implementation is made by this task.

budgets.context_budget: rating audit, resolver, render, CSS, Elementor icons
budgets.research_budget: local code and Elementor icon controls

risks: A superficial star-only patch would leave rating semantics, accessibility, and binding weak.
